title: Diversity and Inclusion in AI: Insights from a Survey of AI/ML Practitioners
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The study focuses on Diversity and Inclusion related to demographics such as gender, race, and ethnicity.

measurement_description: The paper is a survey of AI/ML practitioners on Diversity and Inclusion (D&I) practices. It did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The study focused on demographics such as gender, race, ethnicity, and experience level.
